results.global_threshold: For positive a,b,k and maintained driving: M<=b/k implies R,C->0; M>b/k and R(0)+C(0)>0 imply convergence to the explicit positive equilibrium. All-degraded remains inactive.
results.regulation: D_dot=-kC(D-b/k); this is a restoring rate-balance relation where machinery persists, not assigned purpose, perception or allostasis.
results.general_necessity: Uniform componentwise production/loss bound with rho(L^-1 B)<1 implies exponential decay. Independent production and nondecaying capacities alter assumptions.
results.hidden_mode: Fixed aggregate observation leaves an unstable difference unobservable in the stated linear plant; no well-posed deterministic causal controller using only that observation stabilizes all nearby initial states.
results.kindness: No universal physical tendency to kindness, widening repair toward all affected centers, or open-ended novelty was proved.
